description: This Java class, CPRespPositions, extends a nested class AuthorizeResponse.RespPositions and defines response field positions for card-present transactions within the 'authorizedotnet' third-party integration of the accounting application. It provides methods to retrieve position indices for response fields and a fixed approval string.

classes.name: CPRespPositions
classes.description: Defines response position mappings for card-present transactions, providing position retrieval and a fixed approval string.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Returns the index position for a given response field name, or -1 if not found.
